title: Sharp Map sheets and no black dead-space box
description:
Map Builder sheets were soft because PDF paint multiplied DPI by zoom-out (under-rasterizing), and the workspace still reserved empty dark padding that looked like a black box. Zooming in hid that padding; zooming back out put the camera in empty space so sheets looked blocked.

Workspace bounds are now content-tight. Zoom-out recenters if sheets leave the view. PDF paint keeps full base DPI for on-screen size and re-rasters with a 0.7× layout floor after zoom so sheets stay sharp.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, then reopen the map workspace.
changeLog: Content-tight Map workspace (no giant black dead-space box).
Recenters on sheets when zooming out into empty space.
Restore sharp PDF paint DPI/oversample after zoom.
Re-raster with a 0.7× layout floor so zoom-in is not soft.
